questions.text: Low Physical Effort, Principle 6 of Universal Design, means design that:

options.text: Requires users to exert the maximum effort possible
Works only for athletic users
Eliminates the need to comply with BP 344
Can be used efficiently and comfortably with minimum fatigue

rationale.b: Universal Design is not limited to athletic users.
rationale.c: Universal Design does not replace BP 344 compliance.
rationale.correct: NC State defines Low Physical Effort as efficient, comfortable use with minimum fatigue.
rationale.takeaway: NC State defines Low Physical Effort as efficient, comfortable use with minimum fatigue.
